name: hungrai-skill
description: An unofficial Claude Code port of the SNICKERS HUNGR.AI campaign: hand Claude a digital candy bar when its last answer was off, and get a blunter second attempt.

plugins.name: hungrai
plugins.description: Feed Claude a digital Snickers when its last answer was too agreeable, over-hedged, or simply off. Re-answers your previous question as a dry, unimpressed persona that takes a bite mid-answer, strips the flattery out, and signs off with the campaign's branded line and fact-check disclaimer.
